description: This file provides utility classes and functions for generating schemas from torch objects, such as types, arguments, function schemas, and return types, primarily used in schema generation for torchgen.

classes.name: TypeGen
classes.description: A utility class that converts examples into torch's base types, list types, or custom class types.

classes.name: ReturnGen
classes.description: A utility class to generate Return objects from example data.

classes.name: ArgumentGen
classes.description: A utility class to generate Argument objects from example data.

classes.name: FunctionSchemaGen
classes.description: A utility class to generate FunctionSchema objects from example inputs and outputs.

methods.name: Argument from_example( name: str, obj: Any, default: str | None, annotation: Annotation | None )
methods.description: Class method in TypeGen to determine the appropriate BaseType, ListType, or CustomClassType from a sample object.

methods.name: FunctionSchema from_example( op_name: str, example_inputs: tuple[tuple[str, Any], ...], example_outputs: tuple[Any, ...], )
methods.description: Class method in ReturnGen to generate a Return object from a sample object and optional name/annotation.

methods.name: Return from_example( name: str | None, obj: Any, annotation: Annotation | None )
methods.description: Class method in ArgumentGen to generate an Argument object from a sample object, name, default value, and annotation.

methods.name: BaseType|ListType|CustomClassType from_example(obj: Any)
methods.description: Class method in FunctionSchemaGen to generate a FunctionSchema based on example input/output tuples.
